source_caption:
In Eat Pray Love (2010) Julia Roberts truly embraced the spirit of the film’s first act, during the "Eat" portion of the film shot in Italy, she famously refused to use spit buckets or fake food because she wanted the scenes to look authentic. She later shared in interviews that she ate entire pizzas and multiple plates of pasta during single shoots, resulting in her gaining around 10 pounds by the time she left Rome to film the remaining acts in India and Bali.

source_details.title: Eat Pray Love
source_details.synopsis: Eat Pray Love is a 2010 American biographical romantic drama film, directed and co-written by Ryan Murphy and starring Julia Roberts as Elizabeth Gilbert. It is based on Gilbert's 2006 memoir, and was released in the United States on August 13, 2010, to mixed reviews from critics. The film was a financial success, grossing $205 million against a $60 million budget.
